criteria.text: The patient has enrolled onto EAY191 and has been given a treatment assignment to ComboMATCH to EAY191-N5 based on the presence of an actionable mutation as defined in EAY191

source.text: Patient must have enrolled onto EAY191 and must have been given a treatment assignment to ComboMATCH to EAY191-N5 based on the presence of an actionable mutation as defined in EAY191

criteria.text: The patient has a HER2 amplified solid tumor except breast cancer.

source.text: Patients must have a HER2 amplified solid tumor except breast cancer.

criteria.text: If IHC is 0 or 1+, the patient is not eligible.

source.text: If IHC is 0 or 1+, patient (pt) is NOT ELIGIBLE regardless of in situ hybridization (ISH)/FISH or next generation sequencing (NGS) status

criteria.text: If IHC is 3+, the patient is eligible.

source.text: If IHC is 3+, pt IS ELIGIBLE regardless of ISH/FISH or NGS status

criteria.text: If IHC is 2+, ISH/FISH or NGS must be positive for the patient to be eligible.

source.text: If IHC is 2+, ISH/FISH OR NGS must be positive for the patient to be ELIGIBLE. Otherwise, pt is NOT ELIGIBLE

criteria.text: The patient has recurrent or persistent disease.

source.text: Patients must have recurrent or persistent disease

criteria.text: The patient has no known evidence of RB1 loss or deletion including copy number loss or deleterious mutation.

source.text: No known evidence of RB1 loss or deletion including copy number loss or deleterious mutation

criteria.text: The patient has disease that can be safely biopsied and agrees to a pre-treatment biopsy or, if disease cannot be safely biopsied, has archival tissue available from within 12 months prior to the date of registration on the ComboMATCH Registration Trial (EAY191).

source.text: Patients must have disease that can be safely biopsied and agree to a pre-treatment biopsy or, if disease cannot be safely biopsied, have archival tissue available from within 12 months prior to the date of registration on the ComboMATCH Registration Trial (EAY191)

criteria.text: The patient has measurable disease based on RECIST 1.1. A second measurable lesion outside of the biopsiable lesion is required.

source.text: Patients must have measurable disease based on RECIST 1.1. A second measurable lesion outside of the biopsiable lesion is required

criteria.text: Patients with treated brain metastases are eligible if follow up brain imaging after central nervous system (CNS) directed therapy shows no evidence of progression for 3 months or more and patient is not on steroids and is asymptomatic.

source.text: Patients with treated brain metastases are eligible if follow up brain imaging after central nervous system (CNS) directed therapy shows no evidence of progression for 3 months or more and patient is not on steroids and is asymptomatic

criteria.text: The patient has no known leptomeningeal disease.

source.text: No known leptomeningeal disease

criteria.text: The patient has received up to 5 prior lines of systemic therapy.

source.text: Patients may have received up to 5 prior lines of systemic therapy

criteria.text: Prior therapy with trastuzumab or pertuzumab, either alone or in combination, antibody drug conjugates (ADC) such as DS8201a or T-DM1 is allowed.

source.text: Prior therapy with trastuzumab or pertuzumab, either alone or in combination, antibody drug conjugates (ADC) such as DS8201a or T-DM1 is allowed

criteria.text: The patient has no prior therapy with HER2 targeting tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKI) such as neratinib or tucatinib.

source.text: No prior therapy with HER2 targeting tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKI) such as neratinib or tucatinib

criteria.text: The patient has no prior therapy with CDK4/6 inhibition.

source.text: No prior therapy with CDK4/6 inhibition

criteria.text: The patient has no cancer directed therapy within 3 weeks prior to registration. For oral therapy, the washout can be reduced to greater than or equal to 5 half lives of the drug. No HER2 targeting ADCs within 30 days prior to registration.

source.text: No cancer directed therapy within 3 weeks prior to registration. For oral therapy, the washout can be reduced to greater than or equal to 5 half lives of the drug. No HER2 targeting ADCs within 30 days prior to registration

criteria.text: The patient is age ≥ 18.

source.text: Age ≥ 18

criteria.text: The patient has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of ≤ 2.

criteria.text: The patient is not pregnant and not nursing.

criteria.text: The patient has a Total bilirubin level ≤ 1.5 x institutional upper limit of normal (ULN).

criteria.text: Patients with known history or current symptoms of cardiac disease, or history of treatment with cardiotoxic agents, should have a clinical risk assessment of cardiac function using the New York Heart Association Functional Classification. To be eligible for this trial, patients should be class 2B or better.
